rtlDecisions.question: In a horizontal rating in RTL, which arrow raises the value?
rtlDecisions.apg: No rating pattern page; the star rating examples are a slider and a radio group, both silent on RTL.

libraries.behaviour: Reversed in RTL: Left raises the value and Right lowers it.
Built from native radio inputs, so arrows are the browser's; the pointer mapping is mirrored when isRtl.

rtlDecisions.reason: Stars fill from inline-start, like a slider.

data.notes: Two valid mappings exist and they disagree on the vertical arrows: as a radio group ArrowDown is the next radio (higher rating), as a slider ArrowUp increases. Pick one per component and test it; we default to radio group for whole stars. RTL: stars fill from the right; ArrowLeft raises the rating (Ant Design reverses its arrows in RTL; Material UI mirrors its pointer mapping and leaves keys to native radios). The accessible name needs Arabic plural categories (one, two, few, many): "نجمة واحدة", "نجمتان", "3 نجوم", "11 نجمة". Half-star glyphs must be mirrored so the filled half is on the right.
